thread:
maria-vendor: Quick update from vendor: H100 wave delayed ~10–14 days for a QA thermal rework. They offered an accelerated small air tranche if we sign updated intake terms.
alex: Which regions can they split to?
maria-vendor: They can do a 10-unit air tranche to NA in 48–72h. Remaining units ship after QA; APAC footprint will be last.
pat: 10 units helps but we have onboarding in APAC next week. Can we loan GPUs from our Dedicated pool to APAC short-term?
leo: Ops can spare 4 nodes for 2–3 weeks without SLA breach. Any more will need finance OK.
pat: Ok, start with 4. We'll also throttle non-prod to those.
maria-vendor: Vendor asks for (a) acceptance of mixed-serial partial shipment; (b) escrow handling for serials; (c) they want us to accept a ‘provisional acceptance’ with DOA policy: 30 days return window, 70% credit if replacement delayed.
alex: 70% credit is not acceptable. Push for prepaid RMA labels plus immediate swap within 14 days or full refund. We can threaten to move next quarter PO to another supplier.
maria-vendor: Noted. I proposed prepaid return labels for 30 days + on-site photos and per-serial manifest 24h before arrival. They said they'd consider 14-day swap if we commit to the airsplit now.
leo: Depot ops: need manifest + serials 24h before arrival and thermal batch photos. If any unit flagged, we quarantine and auto-RMA.
pat: How about customs? Any FRA/HKG hold risk?
maria-vendor: Carrier flagged possible HS code mismatch for FRA. ops-bot: AWB 987-65432100 61 status: held @ FRA customs pending invoice HS correction.
leo: Provide HS 8542.31 and request vendor amend invoice. If invoice doesn't match, customs brokerage fees escalate.
alex: Cost question: air tranche adds ~$9k freight + brokerage. Finance needs to pre-approve cross-region billing for the temporary loaned units.
finance-bot: Transfer form required: /forms/transfer. Estimate add-on freight credit: $9,200. Attach to transfer request.
pat: If vendor covers expedited brokerage, ok to accept airsplit. Can vendor commit to that?
maria-vendor: They're willing to cover expedited brokerage for NA airsplit if we sign the provisional acceptance addendum by EOD. They will also include manifest and per-serial photos within 12h.
leo: Ops confirms we can ingest 10 units next-day if manifest and photos are clean. Depot requests that we receive a CSV manifest and a scanned packing list.
alex: Also insist on vendor prepaying return labels for DOA units for first 30 days and provide a replacement SLA of 14 days max.
maria-vendor: Pushback on full 14-day SLA for global replacement, but they agreed to prepaid labels + expedited refurb credit if replacement can't ship within 14 days.
pat: Fine. We'll accept that if vendor also provides a per-serial QA photo set and a commitment to amend the invoice for FRA.
maria-vendor: I'll get written confirmation. Also negotiating whether we can release payment holdback for QA-sensitive batches.
leo: Ops request: create dedicated tracking thread for these AWBs and RMA cases; tag depot, procurement, and legal.
maria-vendor: Will do. Carrier update: AWB 987-65432100 61 vendor preparing amended invoice (ETA docs 2h).
finance-bot: Finance pre-approves temporary loan of 4 units at discounted internal transfer rate 0.6x for 21 days contingent on attaching $9.2k freight estimate to transfer form.
alex: Ok proceed. @maria-vendor please attach the amended invoice and the acceptance addendum by EOD so we can sign and move air.
maria-vendor: On it. I'll post the signed addendum and manifest when ready. Thanks. :thumbsup:
